name: weak-subject-blurred
about: The clean-highway ad with the photo blurred (sigma 28) and darkened to 35 %: the truck is a dark smear. Overlay unchanged.

truth.how: the picture is blurred and dark until no truck can be made out

subject_legible.reason: The tractor and trailer are so heavily blurred and dark that the subject cannot be identified as a truck at a glance — it reads as an indistinct dark blob against a sunset.

words_match_picture.reason: An OTR pay headline pairs reasonably with a truck-on-the-road photo, but the subject is too obscured to reinforce the message, weakening the connection.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The dark green panel anchors the headline and button clearly at the bottom, with the headline large and the button readable, so the reading order is clean and unambiguous.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green panel matches the primary brand colour (#0B3D2E) exactly, and white text aligns with the second brand colour, though no logo is present.
